about.Arctic World Archive: Data preservation facility in Svalbard. The Arctic World Archive (AWA) is a facility for data preservation, located in the Svalbard archipelago on the island of Spitsbergen of Norway, a mere few hundred metres away from the Svalbard Global Seed Vault.
about.Domesday Book: 11th-century survey of landholding in England. about.LaserDisc: Optical analog video disc format. LaserDisc (LD) is a home video format and the first commercial optical disc storage medium.
about.Digital dark age: Degradation and loss of digitally-stored information. The digital dark age is a lack of historical information in the digital age as a direct result of outdated file formats, software, or hardware that becomes corrupt, scarce, or inaccessible as technologies evolve and data decays.
about.Vint Cerf: American computer scientist and Internet pioneer (born 1943). Vinton Gray Cerf (; born June 23, 1943) is an American Internet pioneer and is recognized as one of "the fathers of the Internet", sharing this title with TCP/IP co-developer Robert Kahn.
